instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Abasi lived with his six younger siblings. Sometimes it was very crowded and noisy at home. Abasi liked to leave and go to his secret spot.

instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: One day, he walked down the steps of the familiar path. He put one foot on each stone and walked to the end. Finally, he arrived at the tree, turned around three times and yelled, “thrice I turn, allow me to return, and see my friends again!”

instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Suddenly, a door appeared in the tree. Abasi went in. Then he greeted all of his friends: Lenny the talking leopard, Chaka the changing chameleon, Hala the gentle hyena and many others.
atoms.sound: Suddenly, a door in the tree appeared. Ahbahsee went in. Then he greeted all of his friends: Lenny the talking leopard, Chaka the changing chameleon, Hala the gentle hyena and many others.

atoms.text: After greeting his friends, he ran across the plain in front of him. At first, the plain seemed really long, but Abasi crossed it in just two steps! Now he stood on the edge of the water.
